description: EXAMPLE consumer classification registry for the fresh-context UAT gate (plan A5). A consuming repo copies this to .claude/context/uat-classification-registry.json and references it from .claude/context/agent-context.md. classify-change.mjs MERGES these patterns with its DEFAULT_TABLE — a consumer can broaden a class or add domain-risk tag rules, but cannot weaken the engine's conservative behaviour: unknown paths remain application-impacting, and harness patterns are always checked before the generic source default. This is machine-readable ON PURPOSE (plan A5): a classifier must never parse its rules out of Markdown prose. Globs use `*` (does not cross '/') and `**` (spans directories), matched against repo-relative POSIX paths.
